author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸಂಸಾರ ಸಾಗರವನೀಸುವುದೆ ಬಲುಕಷ್ಟ
ಹಂಸಕ್ಷೀರದ ನ್ಯಾಯವಳವಡಿಸೆ ಕ್ಷೇಮ
ಕಂಸಕೂಡಿಸಿ ಬಾಳ ವರ್ತುಲವ ತುಂಬುತಿರೆ
ಕಂಸಾರಿ ಹರಸುವನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: It is very hard to swim across the ocean of saṃsāra;
to adopt the swan’s rule of milk and water is safe;
if you keep filling the circle of life by adding in bronze,
Kaṃsa’s foe will bless you, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Crossing the sea of worldly life is hard. Like the swan said to separate milk from water, discern the essential from the worthless. Then Kṛṣṇa, Kaṃsa’s destroyer, will bless you. The verse plays on haṃsa, kaṃsa (bronze) and Kaṃsa.
